The main takeaway from our work is that

EHEC-Hemolysin is not lytic towards the target cells but causes apoptosis by a novel mechanism involving the release of OMVs from the bacteria, endocytosis by the cells, trafficking into the endo-lysosomes, and subsequent escape of the toxin from these compartments to target mitochondria and trigger their apoptosis.
EHEC-Hemolysin, a bacterial virulence factor, is able to target mitochondria of host cells and cause their apoptosis.
